entries.subject: DAMIT 6189: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 6189, version 2022-02-14, pole (54°, -11°), period 29.8493 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 6190 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 108.309 ± 0.868 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 108.309 ± 0.868 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown rotation "29.8493 hours" (damit-models) differs from the LCDB V4.0 summary record 786 period 29.434 h (U 3-, synodic); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.

entries.subject: Bredichina whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 19 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.958 at 462 nm, 1.024 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#41403e in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 5.2% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.8%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
